acceptance_criteria.criterion: Running ./menu.sh displays a status block below the version line showing one line per instant-tier health check.
Passing checks render as green checkmark with label; failing checks render as red X with label and fix hint dimmed.
The statusLines callbacks contain no await, no async, and do not call runChecks().
Running ./menu.sh with all instant checks passing exits the status block cleanly with a blank line before the command list.

summary: Built STATUS_LINES from instant-tier checks only: each callback calls check.detect() synchronously, returns C.green('\u2713 label') on pass, C.red('\u2717 label') + C.dim(' \u2014 fix') on fail, C.yellow('\u26a0 ...') if detect() mistakenly returns Promise.
Added statusLines: STATUS_LINES to createMenu() config.
Bumped @mistralys/cli-menu to ^1.1.0 in package.json. npm install successful. 80 tests pass.

summary: All 5 acceptance criteria verified and met.

comments.note: STATUS_LINES builder correctly filters to cost === 'instant'. By typedef contract (health-checks.js), instant-tier detect() returns boolean — not Promise. The instanceof Promise guard is a sound defensive pattern for runtime safety if the contract were accidentally violated. Clean.
The fixHint pattern (check.fix ? C.dim(— fix) : '') correctly handles optional fix text. Zero-cost path when fix is absent. Consistent with the existing C.dim() usage in the codebase.
No blocking issues. All 5 ACs confirmed met. Minimal, focused change: 16 lines of new logic in cli.js and one package.json version bump.
